record.subtitle: Regulation time, from recorded results only

features.title: As the models see it
features.subtitle: Feature set {version} for fixture {fixture}, cut-off {cutoff} ({side} side)
features.notEnough: Not enough history for this feature.
features.none: No feature set includes this team yet.

shots.title: Shots, last 10 matches with statistics
shots.subtitle: Team statistics as recorded, API-Football preferred over Football-Data when both exist

models.title: Research registry
models.subtitle: Every stored experiment and its model gate. A model leaves RESEARCH only with all six checks passed - out of sample, temporal validation, calibration, reproduction, stability, and beating the market.
models.reruns_one: {count} reproduction run not listed: each is linked from the experiment it re-ran.
models.reruns_other: {count} reproduction runs not listed: each is linked from the experiment it re-ran.

calibration.title: Is the closing line calibrated?
calibration.subtitle: {baseline}, one-vs-rest over home, draw and away on {n} fixtures. On the diagonal: stated probabilities come true at their rate.

closing.title: What the last hours of trading add
closing.subtitle: Log loss of the de-vigged Pinnacle pre-closing and closing prices on the same fixtures; the difference is what the market learned before kick-off.
closing.noPrices: No closing prices for this season.

coverage.title: Data coverage
coverage.subtitle: Per competition and season, how many fixtures carry each kind of data. Events, lineups and player statistics arrive with the paid historical migration.

plan.title: Plan
plan.subtitle: The newest stored migration plan (python -m scripts.migration seed)
plan.name: Plan
plan.none: No plan stored yet - units seeded directly

units.title: Units
units.subtitle: Resumable units by kind and status

captured.title: Fixtures with captured prices
captured.subtitle: Implied probabilities are raw (1/odds); de-vigged probabilities appear only in the consensus.

board.title: {home} v {away}
board.subtitle: Latest price per bookmaker, and the best available per selection

movement.title: Line movement
movement.subtitle: First and last captured price per bookmaker and selection

nearClose.title: Near-close
nearClose.subtitle: The capture closest to kick-off our cadence allowed. Not a closing line until validated.

historical.liveConsensusHint: fixtures with a de-vigged consensus from our captures

margins.title: Bookmaker margins
margins.subtitle: Overround per book and price kind: the sum of 1/odds across a market. Best-price share counts how often a named book had the top 1X2 price (ties count for each).
margins.averageNotOffered: An average is not a price anyone offered.

movement.title: Pre-closing → closing
movement.subtitle: Pinnacle, de-vigged with Shin. How far the price moved between the source's two collections, and which of the two predicted the result better.
movement.note: The source collects pre-closing prices on Friday or Tuesday afternoons; neither kind has an exact timestamp, so this is movement between two labelled collections, not a line history.

slices.intro: ± is a 95% interval on the ROI from the spread of bet results (shown from 30 bets). An interval that contains 0 means the result is not distinguishable from luck. “Model expected” is what the model's own EV promised for the same bets.

historicalTables.noPrice: The source has no price for this selection.
historicalTables.compositeNotBook: A best-price composite is not a book: its prices were never offered together.
historicalTables.compositeNotBookShort: A best-price composite is not a book.
historicalTables.notDevigged: Not de-vigged: a composite of best prices has no margin to remove.
historicalTables.noBaseline: No de-vigged baseline was computed for this book.
